svg.text: ACETIC ACID / ACRYLIC ACID SPLIT · PACKED, 2 BEDS
Dt 2.3 m · Ht 25 m · DESIGN FV / 3.5 BAR G
TOP 7.0 kPa a / 48 °C · BOTTOM 15.7 kPa a / 89 °C
CONTROL VALVE, DIAPHRAGM · FC/FO = FAIL CLOSED/OPEN
REMOTE HAND VALVE HV (DCS HIC) · FAIL POS. HOLD
PV PROCESS VAPOUR · PL PROCESS LIQUID · VG VACUUM GAS
LS LP STEAM · MS MP STEAM · SC STEAM CONDENSATE
CW COOLING WATER · CHW CHILLED WATER · NG NITROGEN
VACUUM COLUMN · 2 PACKED BEDS · Dt 2.3 × Ht 25 m
REBOILER, THERMOSIPHON · 0.99 MW · LS 3.5 BAR A
REFLUX DRUM, HORIZ. · Dd 1.0 m × Ld 2.5 m
1. DESIGN BASIS: LECTURE 7 "HYDRAULIC UNIT" (2105416), VACUUM SECTION; TOWLER & SINNOTT ACRYLIC ACID TOWER: TOP 7.0 kPa a / 48 °C, BTM 15.7 kPa a / 89 °C.
2. FEED 10.0 t/h (30 wt% ACETIC ACID) ENTERS BETWEEN THE BEDS. TOP PRODUCT CRUDE ACETIC ACID (FV-103), BOTTOMS ACRYLIC ACID (FV-105). PRODUCT FLOWS TBC.
3. AIR-LEAK BASIS (HEI): SYSTEM VOLUME 105.8 m³ × 1.25 = 132 m³ → W = C·V^(2/3) = 0.7152 × 132^(2/3) = 18.54 kg/h AIR → J-201 RATING (VD-PID-201).
4. E-102 0.99 MW, CW 30 → 40 °C (≈ 85 m³/h); E-101 0.99 MW ON LP STEAM 3.5 BAR A; E-103 ON CHILLED WATER 7 °C, VENT GAS OUT 12 °C.
5. E-103 CONDENSATE DRAINS BACK TO V-101 THROUGH THE VENT LINE: SLOPE DN50-VG-104 TOWARDS V-101, NO POCKETS.
6. PIC-101 (TOP PRESSURE, SP 7.0 kPa a) OUTPUT GOES TO PV-201 N2 BLEED AT THE EJECTOR SUCTION ON VD-PID-201 (OFF-SHEET SIGNAL).
7. INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT & TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN). UNTAGGED MANUAL VALVES = ISOLATION / MAINTENANCE (NOT SIMULATED).
8. ADDED TAG: ST-101 (E-101 CONDENSATE TRAP). ORIFICE ELEMENTS BELONG TO FIC-101 / 102 / 104 AND FI-103 / 105 / 106 (FE NOT TAGGED SEPARATELY).
9. TBC: LINE SIZES, EXCHANGER AREAS, PUMP RATINGS, PRODUCT FLOWS, AIT RANGES, PSV-101 RELIEF LOAD (N2 FAILURE CASE). ALARM SETTINGS: C&E VD-IN-CE-001.
10. REV B: FI-103, FI-105, FI-106 AND HIC-102 / HIC-103 ADDED (DCS TAGS OF THE SIMULATOR); HV-102 / HV-103 SHOWN REMOTE-OPERATED. FAIL POSITIONS OF HV: HOLD.
11. HOLD — RECOMMENDED, NOT INSTALLED (NOT DRAWN): PRESSURE INITIATOR TO I-1 BELOW THE 95 °C PRESSURE (R01), CW LOW INITIATOR (R09), LSHH ON V-101 (R22),
PUMP DRY-RUN PROTECTION (R24), RUPTURE DISC UNDER PSV-101 (R16), FULL-VACUUM DESIGN CONFIRMATION (R17). SEE SAFETY LAYERS / LOPA.
12. NUMBERS FROM THE SIMULATOR MODEL (STEAM EJECTOR VACUUM OTS VER 1) AND THE LECTURE DESIGN BASIS. ISSUED FOR TEACHING.
I-1 TRIP (LATCHED, MANUAL RESET): TSHH-104 > 100 °C OR PSHH-102 > 30 kPa a (ARMED IN RUN ONLY) OR LSHH-102 > 90 % — EACH 5 s
CONTINUOUS — OR ESD PUSH-BUTTON (HS-ESD) → CLOSE XV-101 (FEED) AND XV-102 (LP STEAM TO E-101); FIC-101 / FIC-102 TO MAN, OUTPUT 0 %
(FV-101 / FV-102 CLOSE). RESET BLOCKED WHILE A CAUSE IS ACTIVE. RE-OPEN PERMISSIVES: TOP < 15 kPa a, E-102 CW ≥ 40 t/h (FI-106),
A. KEEP THE BOTTOMS BELOW 95 °C: ACRYLIC ACID POLYMERISES AT HIGHER TEMPERATURE (TI-104 HIGH ALARM 95 °C, BELOW THE I-1 TRIP).
B. BREAK VACUUM WITH N2 ONLY (HV-202 ON VD-PID-201) — NEVER WITH AIR.
C. COLUMN MUST BE TIGHT FOR VACUUM: FLANGES AND SIGHT GLASSES MINIMISED; LEAK-TEST BEFORE START-UP.
D. CONTROL: FIC-101 FEED · FIC-102 STEAM (BOIL-UP) · FIC-104 REFLUX · LIC-101 → FV-103 DISTILLATE · LIC-102 → FV-105 BOTTOMS.
E. PSV-101 SET 3.5 BAR G (= DESIGN PRESSURE), DISCHARGES TO FLARE: PROTECTS AGAINST N2 OVERPRESSURE.
F. ASSUMED VALUES (MARKED TBC) ARE FOR OTS TRAINING ONLY.
